title: Constructing a nuanced argument / Kugenzura ikibazo cy’umwimerere
bridge: Mu gihugu cy’Cyongereza, gutondeka ikibazo cy’umwimerere kigenzwa n’ubwenge n’amagambo yo kubroka (e.g., ‘somewhat’, ‘arguably’), imisusi yo kwemeza (e.g., ‘might’, ‘could’), no kugabanya amatsinda yo kwemeza (e.g., ‘although’, ‘while’). Ahubwo mu Icyongereza, iby’umwimerere birangwa n’uburyo bwo kugabanya amagambo no kwandika amatsinda, si nk’mu Igifaransa, aho iby’umwimerere birangwa n’uburyo bwo kwemeza. Ikibazo kinini cy’ubugenzuzi ni guhindura uburyo bwo kwemeza mu Icyongereza nk’ubwo mu Igifaransa, ‘aunque pudiera ser’ birahinduka ‘although it could be’ cyangwa ‘while it might be’.
rule: Kugenzura ikibazo cy’umwimerere mu Icyongereza ku mubare w’C1, hindura: 1) Amagambo yo kubroka (e.g., ‘arguably’, ‘apparently’, ‘probably’) kugena ubwenge bwawe. 2) Imisusi yo kwemeza (might, may, could) kugena ubwenge bw’ibintu. 3) Amatsinda yo kwemeza (although, even though, while, whereas) kugena ibintu bishyashya. 4) Amatsinda nk’ ‘it could be argued that...’, ‘one might say that...’, ‘this is not to say that...’ kugena iby’umwimerere. Komeza uburyo bwo kugabanya amagambo: mu Icyongereza, iby’umwimerere bira ku mwishura cyangwa ku buryo, ahubwo ntibira kugabanya umuntu n’imyaka yawe nk’aho birabana mu Igifaransa. Nta ‘maybe’ (informal) mu mibare yo kwemeza; hitamo ‘perhaps’ cyangwa ‘possibly’.

title: Critical Analysis and Evaluation / Ubuvuzi n’Ububiko bw’amajambo
bridge: Mu gihugu, dusaba gusaba ubuvuzi bw’amajambo n’uburyo bwa kugira ngo ‘ndabona ko’, ‘ni byo cyohereza kumenya’ cyangwa gusaba iby’umunsi. Mu Icyongereza, ikimenyetso ni kugira ubumenyi bw’amagambo yo kuri kuri (may, might, could) kugira ngo ubone uburyo, amagambo yo kuri kuri (highly, somewhat, arguably) n’uburyo bwa kugira ibitekerezo by’umunsi (It is worth noting). Ikibazo gihuye ni kugira ngo ‘must’ kuri buri kintu cyo kuri ‘debe ser’, mu gihugu ‘must’ bishobora gutanga ubumenyi bw’uburyo bwa kumenya, si uburyo bwa kumenya. Nanone ni byo cyohereza kumenya kumenya uburyo bwa kumenya uburyo bwa kumenya: mu gihugu dusaba ‘I would argue’ mu cyo ‘I think definitely’.
rule: Kugira ubuvuzi bw’amajambo mu Icyongereza ku murongo C1, onga: 1) Amagambo yo kuri kuri kugira uburyo bwa kumenya: 'must' (uburyo bwa kumenya), 'may/might/could' (uburyo bwa kumenya), 'can't' (uburyo bwa kumenya). 2) Amagambo yo kuri kuri: 'highly', 'extremely', 'somewhat', 'arguably', 'undoubtedly'. 3) Uburyo bwa kugira ibitekerezo by’umunsi: 'It is worth noting that...', 'It could be argued that...', 'The evidence suggests...'. 4) Amagambo yo kuri kuri: 'I would argue', 'I contend', 'I maintain' (byinshi kurushaho ‘I think’). 5) Uburyo bwa kugira ibitekerezo by’umunsi: 'however', 'nevertheless', 'whereas’. Ntukoreshe ‘I think’ mu gucyora mu miko; onga ‘This implies that...' cyangwa ‘It could be inferred that...’. Kugira ubuvuzi, onga ‘strengths and weaknesses’, ‘implications’, ‘limitations’.

title: Irony and Understatement / Ironiya, isarukizo n’amahani
bridge: Mu gaciri, ironiya na isarukizo birashirwa n’ubwoko bw’inyungu n’amahani atandukanye (nk’uko ni ‘claro’, ‘por supuesto’, ‘como no’), kandi harakoreshwa amagambo menshi cyangwa magufi. Mu Icyongereza, ironiya ifitezwa n’ubwoko bw’inyungu bwa kirekire n’amahani menshi, kandi eufemismo ni igikoresho cy’ubwoko bw’umwimerere bukomeye kugira ngo ubashe imibonano y’ukuri. Ikiganiro gikomeye: mu Icyongereza, gusabwa gutanga (‘understatement’) ni uburyo bw’ironiya (ugira ‘not bad’ kugira ngo ubereke ‘excelente’), ibintu byoshobora kuba bitangaje abanyarwanda kandi barenya kubika mu buryo bw’inyoma (‘no está mal’), bakorera ibintu by’ubushakashatsi. Nanone, kuba munzigiye: isarukizo mu Icyongereza irashobora kuba irambuye kurushaho mu gaciri, kandi gutanga amagambo ni cyo cyihutirwa cyane kugira ngo ubashe ibibazo.
rule: Mu Icyongereza ku murongo C1, ironiya na eufemismo bifitirwa nka 1) Understatement: koresha amagambo menshi cyangwa magufi kugira ngo ubereke ibintu by’ubushakashatsi (nk’uko ni ‘It's not the worst idea’ = ‘ni idea nziza cyane’; ‘a bit’ cyangwa ‘slightly’ bifite ubwoko bw’ubushakashatsi). 2) Isarukizo: ifitirwa n’ubwoko bw’inyungu n’amahani (bwa kirekire cyangwa kihagije), ariko no ku misoro nk’uko ni ‘Oh, great!’, ‘Well, that's just perfect’ cyangwa ‘I love it when...’. 3) Eufemismo: gutunga amagambo menshi mu buryo bwa kirekire (nk’uko ni ‘passed away’ mu buryo ‘died’, ‘let go’ mu buryo ‘fired’, ‘between jobs’ mu buryo ‘unemployed’, ‘full-figured’ mu buryo ‘fat’). Imisoro yihutirwa: amagambo menshi (‘hardly’, ‘barely’, ‘scarcely’) kugira ngo ubereke understatement; ibibazo by’ubushakashatsi (‘Is that so?’) kugira ngo ubereke ironiya; misoro y’amahani ‘just’, ‘only’, ‘a bit’ nk’uburyo bwo kugabanya. Ibikorwa: ntibintu byose byoshobora kuba bifite ironiya; mu bihe by’ubushakashatsi, isarukizo ntibikoreshwa. Eufemismo irashobora kuba iri mu buryo bwa kurema: mu bihe by’ubushakashatsi bikoreshwa kurushaho.

title: Indirect Speech Acts and Implicature / Imikorere y’indilimiyemo n’imikorere y’ubwoko
bridge: Mu gaciri, imikorere y’indilimiyemo birangwa n’ubwoko bw’inyungu cyangwa n’amatsiko atandukanye nk’ ‘¿Me pasas la sal?’ bishobora kuba birangwa neza. Mu Icyongereza, ubwoba bw’indilimiyemo bufite ubushishozi bungaruka, kandi bishobora kugaragazwa n’amabwiriza yo muri modasi (could, would), ibibazo bitangiye na aha, n’ubushake bw’ikinyejana (I was wondering) kugira ngo ububaze umubaza. Abanyarwanda bashobora kuba bafite ubwoba bungaruka mu Icyongereza, kandi ibyo bishobora gutuma bishushanye cyangwa bigaragara bishishikanywe. Nanone, imikorere y’ubwoko (imibereho) itegerezwa ku mpamvu w’ubushishozi; mu Icyongereza, umunyaruguze ashobora kugira ngo yibuke ibintu atavuze, ariko ubwoko bw’inyungu bufite ubushishozi.
rule: Imikorere y’indilimiyemo mu Icyongereza birangwa n’ibintu bikurikira: 1) Ibibazo bitangiye na ‘can/could/would you...’ kugira ngo ububaze umubaza (Could you close the window?), 2) ‘I was wondering if...’ kugira ngo ububaze umubaza mu buryo bw’ubwoba (I was wondering if you could help me), 3) Ibibazo bitangiye na aha kugira ngo usabe ububaza cyangwa ukore igisubanuro (Don't you think it's too late?), 4) ‘It might be a good idea to...’ kugira ngo usabe ububaza mu buryo bw’ubwoba. Kuri imikorere y’ubwoko, ubushake bw’ubushishozi bw’i Grice bukoreshwa; mu muvugo nk’ ‘I'm cold’, ubushake bw’ubushishozi bukomeye kugira ngo ububaze umubaza. Mu C1, wishirwa ko umwanafunzi azibuka n’akoresha ibyo mu buryo bw’ubwoba.

title: Structuring Formal Presentations / Gutunganya ibyago bya kinyejana
bridge: Mu gaciri, dutegura amagambo nk' ‘mu kanya kawa’, ‘ahubwo’ cyangwa ‘mu gitondo’ kugutunga umugambi. Mu Icyongereza, igitungano kirenze kuba kirekire n’ikimaze neza, hamagara amagambo nk’ ‘firstly’, ‘furthermore’, ‘but more importantly’, na ‘in light of this’. Ikibazo gikomeye ni guhindura ‘por un lado’ kuba ‘on one side’ ahandi ‘on the one hand’, cyangwa kugura ‘in conclusion’ ahandi umusarurozi w’icyongereza yifuzwa ‘to sum up’ cyangwa ‘ultimately’. Ubundi, igishushanyo n’uburyo bwo kugura amagambo ntibifana: mu Icyongereza, amagambo menshi n’ibimaze neza ari yo bifuzwa, mu gihugu cy’Icyongereza, bashimira guhindura amagambo.
rule: Mu byago bya kinyejana mu Icyongereza (C1), bashimira kugura amagambo n’igitungano kirekire kigutunga umugambi mu buryo bwa kumenya n’ubutunzi. Mu kwinjiriro, tugura ibintu nk’ ‘I would like to begin by...’, ‘Let me start by...’, cyangwa ‘The purpose of this presentation is to...’. Kugutunga: ‘Firstly’, ‘Secondly’, ‘Furthermore’, ‘Moreover’, ‘In addition’. Kugira ubwoko: ‘However’, ‘On the other hand’, ‘Nevertheless’. Kugira icyo kintu: ‘Indeed’, ‘In fact’, ‘It is important to note that’. Gutonda: ‘In conclusion’, ‘To summarize’, ‘In light of the evidence’. Ntushobora kugura amagambo nk’ ‘it’s’ ahandi ‘it is’ cyangwa amagambo y’icyongereza. Ni cyikeye kugura ‘we’ (ntushobora kugura ‘we can see that...’). Ibyo tugura n’uburyo bwo kugura, naho ntibiri mu magambo, ni bikorwa kugira ngo byemeze. Mu byago bya kinyejana, bashimira kugura ‘present simple’ n’ ‘present perfect’ kugura ibyo bishize, na ‘conditional’ kugura ibintu byagombaye.

title: Hedging and Boosting in Academic Writing / Gutungura no Kuwungura mu Andika Akademike
bridge: Mu ikinyarwanda, abagenzi baharanira gushimisha ibintu bitoranyije amashusho kandi ibiganisha nk’ ‘byari bite’ cyangwa ‘byari ngo’, ariko mu andika akademike y’Icyongereza, gutungura kigaragara neza n’amashusho nk’ ‘suggest’ cyangwa ‘appear’. Ikibazo kinini ni guhindura ‘byari ngo’ kuba ‘it is possible that’, kandi kigaragaza neza ariko ntikigaragaza neza kurusha ibintu nk’ ‘may’ cyangwa ‘could’. Nanone, kugirwa gutungura cyane: mu andika akademike y’Icyongereza, bikorwa gutanga ubushishozi n’ubutunzi, si kwihutisha amahoro menshi.
rule: Mu andika akademike y’Icyongereza, amashusho y’gutungura yongerewa kugira ngo yungure ibintu by’ukuri kandi yihindure ibintu by’ukuri byose. Ibintu by’ingenzi ni: 1) Amashusho y’ubwoko: may, might, could (ntanga, ‘This may indicate...’), 2) Amashusho y’ubwoko/amahoro: often, sometimes, possibly, presumably (ntanga, ‘This possibly suggests...’), 3) Amashusho y’ubwoko: suggest, appear, seem (ntanga, ‘The data suggest that...’), 4) Amashusho y’ubwoko: it could be argued that, there is evidence to suggest. Kuri kuwungura (boosting), amashusho nk’ clearly, undoubtedly, definitively, cyangwa amashusho nk’ prove, demonstrate yongerewa. Ni cyihutire kugirwa gutungura n’ikuwungura: igisubizo nk’ ‘This clearly may be true’ si cyo k’ukuri kubera ko bikorana n’ubushishozi. Nanone, mu andika akademike y’Icyongereza y’ubwoko, inyandiko y’ubwoko ‘I’ ntibikoreshwa mu bindi binyandiko, bikorwa gutanga amashusho y’ubwoko cyangwa y’ubwoko.

title: Advanced Negotiation Strategies / Uburenganzira bw’ibirebaniremo bigaragara
bridge: Mu igifaransa, mu birebaniremo, dusaba gusaba ibirimo amatangazo menshi cyangwa amatangazo y’ingenzi nk’uko ‘ndabagiranye’ cyangwe ‘ntubishimye’. Mu icyongereza, uburebaniremo bw’ibiri mugari burakorwa neza kuri amatangazo y’ubwenge (would, could, might), mu majwi y’ubwenge n’ubwenge bw’ubushakashatsi kugira ngo uburenze n’ubushakashatsi. Ubwenge bw’icyongereza burakorwa neza kuri ‘unless’ na ‘provided that’ kugira ngo uburenze ubwenge, ibyo bitangaza ntibifite ubwenge bw’ingenzi mu igifaransa kandi bishobora gutuma ubwenge bw’ubushakashatsi. Ubwenge bw’icyongereza burakorwa neza kuri amatangazo y’ubwenge nk’uko ‘I was wondering if’ mu buryo bwo kwinjira mu by’ubushakashatsi, ibyo mu igifaransa bishobora gutuma ubwenge bw’ubushakashatsi.
rule: Kugira ngo uburebaniremo bw’ibiri mugari mu icyongereza, jya uburenze ibyo ubwenge: 1) Ubwenge bw’ubwenge (first, second, third) kugira ngo uburenze iby’ubushakashatsi: ‘If we were to extend the deadline, we would need a discount’. 2) Amatangazo y’ubwenge kugira ngo uburenze ubwenge n’ubwenge: ‘I would suggest’, ‘We could consider’, ‘I might be open to’. 3) Majwi y’ubwenge n’ubwenge bw’ubushakashatsi na ‘although’, ‘however’, ‘while’ kugira ngo uburenze ubwenge bw’ubushakashatsi cyangwa iby’ubushakashatsi. 4) Ubwenge bw’ubushakashatsi n’ubwenge bw’ubushakashatsi: ‘meet you halfway’, ‘a win-win situation’, ‘bottom line’. 5) Ubwenge bw’ubwenge na ‘unless’, ‘provided that’, ‘as long as’ kugira ngo uburenze ubwenge bw’ubushakashatsi: ‘We can agree, provided that you cover shipping costs’. 6) Ibibazo by’ubushakashatsi kugira ngo uburenze ubwenge bw’ubushakashatsi: ‘I was wondering if you would consider a different payment schedule’. By’ingenzi: ntukoreshe ‘I want’ cyane; koresha ‘I would like’ cyangwe ‘We are looking for’. Uburenganzira: mu birebaniremo by’ubushakashatsi (hard negotiation) ushobora kuba mubwenge, ariko ntumwa neza. Kanga ubwenge bw’ubushakashatsi bw’igifaransa ‘no me gusta’ na ‘I don't like it’ - mu icyongereza burenze na ‘I'm not entirely comfortable with that’.

title: Nuanced Expression of Attitude / Kugena ubwoba no kwigisha ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso
bridge: Mu gihugu, dusaba kugena ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso no kwigisha ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bwa muntu buri wese kandi dusaba gutumiza amagambo menshi (nk’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso, ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bw’umuntu). Mu Icyongereza, ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso no kwigisha ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bwa muntu buri wese buri kandi dusaba gutumiza amagambo menshi (nk’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso, ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bw’umuntu). Ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso no kwigisha ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bwa muntu buri wese buri kandi dusaba gutumiza amagambo menshi (nk’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso, ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bw’umuntu). Ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso no kwigisha ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bwa muntu buri wese buri kandi dusaba gutumiza amagambo menshi (nk’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso, ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bw’umuntu). Ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso no kwigisha ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bwa muntu buri wese buri kandi dusaba gutumiza amagambo menshi (nk’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso, ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bw’umuntu).
rule: Kugena ubwoba no kwigisha ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso mu Icyongereza mu matora w’C1, dusaba gutumiza: (1) Amagambo menshi (may, might, could, would, should) yagena ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso, ububiko, ubushishozi cyangwa ububiko; (2) Amagambo menshi y’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso (arguably, admittedly, typically, surprisingly) yagena ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso cyangwa ubwoba bw’umuntu; (3) Amagambo menshi y’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso (It's fair to say, It could be argued that) yagena ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bw’umuntu; (4) Amagambo menshi y’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso (I'd suggest, I'd maintain, I'd contend) n’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bw’umuntu. Mu bwoba, dusaba gutumiza 'not' + 'at all', 'hardly', 'scarcely' kugena ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso. Dusaba kugena ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bw’umuntu ‘I think’ cyangwa ‘I believe’ bihutirwa.

common_error.explanation: Ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bw’umuntu buri kandi dusaba gutumiza 'I believe' na 'I think' mu buryo buri kandi dusaba gutumiza, ubwo mu Icyongereza buri kandi dusaba gutumiza ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso no kwigisha ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bwa muntu buri wese. Mu C1, dusaba ko umuntu yagena ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso n’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso bw’umuntu ‘would’ (I'd say), amagambo menshi nk’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso, na amagambo menshi nk’ubwoba bw’ibiryumvenso cyangwa ‘maintain’. title: Register Shifting / Gusabana umwirondoro kuringana umwanya
bridge: Mu igifaransa, umwirondoro ubonekanijwe n'uburyo bwo kwerekana amajwi nk'uwu 'tú' na 'usted' cyangwa imwezi z'amajwi. Mu icyongereza, umwirondoro ntibonye umwanya mu kwerekana, ahubwo mu gutondora ibyago, umwanya w'amajambo na kugirangirwa kwa gikorwa cyangwa ibyago by'amajambo. Abanyarwanda bashobora gushyiraho icyapa kinini cyane cyangwa kirekire aho nticyizere, hasi mu gukorera ibyemejwe mu buryo bw'anditsiko. Ni cyo kibazo kumenya neza amafomula y'ubwubahe (nk'uwu 'I was wondering if...') na 'hedging' ('might', 'could', 'perhaps') kugira ngo ubone umwirondoro uri cyiza mu ibiro ry'ubwubahe.
rule:
Mu icyongereza, umwirondoro ubanzirizwa kuringana umwanya (ubwubahe, ubwishyuze, kirekire) bishobora kugirwa na ibyo bikurikira:

1. Ibyago: Amajambo yubwubahe n'iy'ubwishyuze (erega 'purchase' vs 'buy', 'receive' vs 'get', 'child' vs 'kid').
2. Uburyo bwo kwandika: Imbonera zikomeye (amajambo yubwubahe, gikorwa cy'ubwubahe) ziboneka ubwubahe; amajambo menshi na zikomeye ziboneka kirekire.
3. Ibyo bishobora kugirwa na modales na hedges: 'Would', 'could', 'might', 'perhaps', 'possibly' zishyiraho ubwubahe mu gutanga ibyishimo n'iby'ubwubahe; mu ibiro ry'ubwishyuze, 'can', 'will', 'maybe' zishimwa.
4. Phrasal verbs: Zibiriwe ko ziri kirekire cyangwa ziri ubwishyuze; mu ibiro ry'ubwubahe, amajambo yubwubahe (erega 'to carry out' vs 'to execute').
5. Contracciones: Ntizigirwa mu anditsiko yubwubahe (ntizigirwa 'don't' ahubwo 'do not').
6. Fórmulas fijas: Mu ibiro ry'ubwubahe n'ibiro ry'anditsiko, amafomula yubwubahe ('Dear Sir/Madam', 'Yours faithfully').
7. Pronombres: Naho ntibiriho ubwoko bw'ubwubahe nk'uwu 'tú/usted', kugirwa kwa 'one' aho 'you' kigira icyapa cyubwubahe (erega 'One must consider...').

Excepciones: Icyongereza cy'Ubuweru burimo ubwubahe mu kugirwa na amafomula kurusha icyongereza cy'Ameerika. Mu ibiro ry'ubwishyuze ry'anditsiko, amajambo menshi na ibyago by'ubwubahe birashobora kugirwa, ariko mu ibiro ry'ubwubahe, byoshobora kugirwa.

title: Pragmatic Styles in Cross-Cultural Communication / Imikorere y’ubushishikazwa mu gukorera hamwe ahantu
bridge: Mu ikinyarwanda, ubwoba no kwivugana ubwacu bwihariye bikorwa n’uburyo bwo kwivugana bwihariye (kubika iby’ubushishikazwa, iby’ubwoba, n’ibindi). Mu Icyongereza, hasi mu bihugu by’Ubuvangayika no mu biro by’ubucuruzi, bikwereka uburyo bwo kwivugana bwihariye no kwigisha uburyo bwo kwivugana bwihariye. Abanyarwanda bakunda kwivugana bwihariye no kwivugana bwihariye, kandi bakunda kwivugana bwihariye no kwivugana bwihariye. Ibikorwa: 'maybe' ntibisigura 'quizás' ahubwo 'baje el tono'; 'I think' mu Icyongereza bikoreshwa n’ubushishikazwa kurushaho 'creo' mu ikinyarwanda.
rule: Mu Icyongereza, ubwoba bwihariye bukorwa n’ibikorwa bihariye: 1) Hedges ('sort of', 'kind of', 'I'd say'), 2) Imirimo y’ubushishikazwa mu kivume (would, could, might) kugira ngo ubushishikazwa bube bwihariye, 3) Ibibazo by’ubwoba cyangwa iby’ubushishikazwa ('couldn't we...?'), 4) Ibikorwa by’ubwoba n’ 'I'm afraid', 'I'd rather'. Mu ikinyarwanda, ubwoba bukorwa n’ubushishikazwa ('me gustaría', 'podrías'), ariko ntibikoreshwa cyane n’ibikorwa by’ubwoba. Mu kwivugana ubwacu bwihariye, abanyarwanda bakunda kwivugana 'I see your point, but...' kandi mu ikinyarwanda 'no estoy de acuerdo' ni byihariye. Kuri C1, kanda uburyo bwo kwivugana bwihariye n’ 'just' na 'actually' kugira ngo ubushishikazwa bube bwihariye.
